profile: Actual saved native-frame inspection plus read-only Node geometry, animation and shadow-matrix diagnosis.
verdictScope: No corrected render or controlled shadow comparison has been validated. This is not a finding that the actor actually floats and not an overall product verdict.
scoreMeaning: Rendered correction verification remains 0 of 1. No game-quality score is assigned.
blindComparison: No reference-work blind comparison was performed. The reviewer knows the development image and source. The analysis cannot determine which anonymous work an evaluator would prefer and marks no element satisfied.
conclusion: The observed separation from the dark shadow does not establish physically floating feet. Actual static rig/idle geometry reaches below the 0.14 m pavement surface; render/collision pavement heights agree. There is no separate blob-shadow mesh or plane. Directional shadow bias is a strong, mathematically supported candidate for weak contact shadows, but its responsibility for this exact image has not been isolated in a GPU comparison.

image.provenance: Saved 3266b95 CI artifact supplied by the coordinator; report/image hash matching was already checked in visual-capture-review.json.
image.observation: Both dark boots end over the paved foreground. The darkest diffuse shadow patch lies toward the lower-left rather than forming an obvious attached contact edge. Shadow-centre displacement alone is not a measurable vertical foot gap.

sourceIdentity.relationToImage: git diff 3266b95 confirms actor, rig, animator, player, atmosphere, world geometry/collision/data and package-lock are unchanged. City differs only in sign construction/material; the ground and streets methods used here are unchanged.

rig.method: Constructed actual Player with actual Ren detail-2 rig and Animator; substituted only MeshStandardMaterial/MeshBasicMaterial creation. Used SkinnedMesh.getVertexPosition after world/skeleton updates. Selected the 12 bottom-face vertex entries of each sole by actual foot skin weights and bind y < -0.002.
rig.interpretation: Bind soles are 3 mm below the 0.14 m pavement. The lowest vertex of each normal idle sole remains about 17–27 mm below it over this sample; other sole corners rise a few centimetres as ankles/hips rotate. This refutes a fixed positive rig-root offset in the tested poses; it is not an exact replay of the captured animation.

terrain.method: Actual City._buildGround/_buildStreets and MeshBuilder in Node with a material-only substitute; excludes unrelated structures and props.
terrain.interpretation: The centre and both sole footprints lie over concrete at y≈0.14 and collision pavement at y=0.14. Asphalt at 0.025 and ash at 0 are below that pavement, not the visible supporting top.

shadow.type: Directional sun shadow map with PCFSoftShadowMap. No blob-shadow object or fixed blob plane exists in src.
shadow.method: Actual Three.js directional shadow matrix and installed shader comparison equation, using current production settings. Ideal same-UV depth examples; no GPU texture, rasterization or PCF simulation.
shadow.interpretation: The installed shader adds -0.0009 to receiver depth after applying a 0.028 m upward normal offset. With this orthographic range, same-UV caster separations up to 0.1341 m along the light ray remain lit. On a horizontal receiver this corresponds to an ideal caster height of 0.148284 m. This is an analytic explanation of suppressed near-contact occlusion, not a measurement of this image's shadow texture.

refutation.fixedFloatingRig: Refuted for bind and normal stationary idle by actual skinned vertices reaching the rendered support plane.
refutation.mismatchedCurbHeight: Refuted at the measured footprint points by actual production mesh raycasts and collision queries.
refutation.misplacedBlobPlane: Refuted by source inspection: the dark region is not produced by a separately positioned blob-shadow plane.
refutation.entirelyLegitimatePose: A few centimetres of toe/heel tilt are produced by the real idle pose. That does not by itself explain or validate the detached shadow appearance.
refutation.shadowBiasAsExactImageCause: Not yet confirmed. The depth-exemption calculation supports the candidate, but does not simulate shadow-map rasterization, PCF taps, surface normal maps or the capture's exact cached actor pose.

nextVerification: Keep the current camera, world and exact rig pose fixed; record the actual foot vertices, supporting surface and shadow-update frame. In the existing permitted WebKit CI, capture the current bias, a bias-only control and an unchanged repeat with native canvas output. Compare the contact region and distant self-shadow artifacts before changing production values. Do not lower the player or reframe the camera to conceal the symptom.
limits: The original artifact omits bone matrices, Animator.time/action/locomotion parameters and shadow-map bytes. The exact captured foot deformation and cached shadow pose cannot be reconstructed from grounded=true and state=idle alone.
No browser was launched, no product file was edited, and no material/lighting/camera correction was applied.

The terrain reconstruction covers actual ground and street generation only; unrelated props/structures were omitted. It proves the pavement exists beneath the feet, not every visible occluder's identity.

The initial Node harness attempt failed because its material-only substitute omitted mats.glow; adding that substitute allowed the unchanged production Player construction to run. The failed attempt supplied no measurement.
